label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (path-injection) alert-TP: User-controlled 'seg' parameter flows directly to redirect URL at line 24 ('https://' + host + '/' + seg) without sanitization. Although host is validated via regex, the path segment '/seg' is unsanitized user input. Resolved sink value includes attacker-controlled 'seg'. This creates an open redirect vulnerability where attackers can manipulate the path component to redirect users to unintended locations within the allowed domain.

evidence.note: User-controlled 'seg' parameter assigned from request.getParameter('seg') with default 'home', then concatenated into redirect URL without sanitization
Sink: response.sendRedirect('https://' + host + '/' + seg) - unsanitized user input reaches redirect destination
